title: NEB Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Automation
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the PCR, Bead Clean Up and Elution steps of the [NEB Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep](https://www.neb.com/products/e7805-nebnext-ultra-ii-fs-dna-library-prep-kit-for-illumina#Protocols,%20Manuals%20&%20Usage) --- * [P20-multi channel GEN2 electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette) * [P300-multi channel GEN2 electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette) * [Opentrons Thermocycler Module](https://opentrons.com/modules/thermocycler-module/) * [Opentrons Temperature Module](https://opentrons.com/modules/temperature-module/) * [Opentrons Magnetic Module](https://opentrons.com/modules/temperature-module/) * [NEST 100uL PCR Plate](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/lab-plates/products/nest-0-1-ml-96-well-pcr-plate-full-skirt) * [Opentrons 96 Well Aluminum Block with 200 uL PCR Strips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/racks-and-adapters/products/aluminum-block-set) --- * Thermocycler (Slot 7) * Temperature Module (Slot 4) * Magnetic Module (Slot 9) * Plate with Index-Primers (Slot 5) * Opentrons 200 uL Filter Tips (Slot 2, 3) * Opentrons 20 uL Filter Tips (Slots 1) Initial Starting State: - Samples with beads in a 96 well PCR plate in the thermocycler. - EB Tween is in column 1 on the 96 Well Aluminum block on the temperature module. - Reservoir channel A1 contains ethanol - Plate on the magnetic module contains pre-aliquoted magnetic beads - Plate with Index-Primers starts in a 96 well plate on Position 5 of deck
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck and load labware
steps.instruction: Place the required modules and labware on the robot deck as follows:

substeps.instruction: 200 µL filter tip racks for the P300‑multi channel in slots 2 and 3.
20 µL filter tip rack for the P20‑multi channel in slot 1.
NEST 100 µL PCR Plate on the Thermocycler Module.
96‑well Aluminum Block (200 µL capacity) on the Temperature Module.

steps.title: Load samples and reagents
steps.instruction: Place all samples and reagents in the locations defined by the deck map:

substeps.instruction: Samples with beads in a 96‑well PCR plate positioned on the Thermocycler Module.
EB Tween solution in column 1 of the 96‑well Aluminum Block on the Temperature Module.
Ethanol in reservoir channel A1 (the ethanol reservoir).
Pre‑aliquoted magnetic beads on the plate sitting on the Magnetic Module.
Index‑Primer plate already positioned in slot 5 (as set above).

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, input the number of samples, assign each pipette (P20‑multi and P300‑multi) to its mount, and indicate whether to run the PCR, bead‑cleanup, and/or elution sections.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Click the “Download” button in the app to save the generated Python protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, use the “Upload” function to load the downloaded protocol onto the OT‑2 robot.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine for each piece of labware and for each pipette (P20‑multi and P300‑multi) using the OT App and the provided calibration tip racks.

steps.title: Start the automated run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to begin the automated PCR, bead‑cleanup, and elution steps of the NEB Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep.
